profile.headline: Software Developer at IBM
profile.summary:
• Product test engineer: 6 years of experience as test engineer in computer PC manufacturing
• Software Engineer: 10 years of experience in software development
• Software Test Engineer: 2 years of experience in software test engineer
• Web Developer: 5 years of experience in web design and development for new entrepreneurs and small businesses.  Links to some of websites designed:
www.liendoanphudong.org
www.almadenautorepair.com
www.aig-tech.com
www.returnsource.com
• Hardware Test: 5 years of experience in testing and troubleshooting DNA medical devices

positions.title: IT and Service Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and setup company network infrastructure.Installed windows serve, network, printers, and remote access to server.  Created and managed users account and usersaccess privilege.Trained users how to remote login to server from LAN and WAN. Setup VPN server on server and VPN client on users’ computer.Installed and setup surveillancecamera system and cameras.Created and managed users email.  Supported company’s employees on day-to-day issues with printers, networking, laptops, and computers, etc…
• Installed and setup the Kronos KT2000 hard drives repair system on customers’ facility.  Provided training the Kronos KT2000 system to customers on components’ function and Kronos Management Software (KMS), how to create report, basic trouble-shooting and how to replace system interface cards.Support customers with questions and issues on the Kronos KT2000.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Analyzed customers’ business need for small businesses, new entrepreneurs, non-profit organizations and consulted customers on website that fit to their business model and requirement.
• Developed and designed database, front-end web applications and back-end web applications using MySQL, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, and JQuery.

positions.title: Sr. Software/Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed the Brooktrout Manager Configuration (BMC) GUI utility application that setup and install company telephony hardware and SDK on customers’ servers.  The GUI of application was developed in Java, and XML to accommodate cross platform issue, and the internal interface was developed in C/C++ to communicate with firmware to query and setup hardware features accordingly
• Consulted Brooktrout’s customers and redesigned customers’ call center applications to utilized Brooktrout telephony hardware products
• Developed test plans, test cases and test scenarios to validate Brooktrout SDK software before it release
• Enhanced and modified automate test software to support new features implemented on Brooktrout telephony hardware
• Installed test software and operating system (Windows and Linux), setup hardware on test stations, executed test plan to validate Brooktrout SDK before it released

positions.title: Engineer Software
positions.description:
• Enhanced and supported Nortel’s Call Center application on Nortel Meridian 1 and Option 61C switches.
• Developed website to support Meridian 1 and Option 61C patches.  It allowed users to download patches that related to different Meridian 1 and Option 61C software version.
